items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, its interesting Bill Russo in one of his composing/arranging books years ago made a statement... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: I don’t think he wrote anything for it but I kind of liked having the light sound for change, I was so sick of the tenors by then, you know the tenors were fine in the mid-40s and later 40s but everybody was tenor happy and I really didn’t like hearing the one alto hanging out there.
Yeah, its interesting Bill Russo in one of his composing/arranging books years ago made a statement, he said that, “one of the biggest lackings in the jazz orchestra is soprano instruments.”
